definitions.explanation: The position at the back of someone or something; the opposite of the front.

examples.japanese: {後|うし}ろ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{後|うし}ろ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}ります→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: I'll sit in the back seat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{後|うし}ろ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ありました→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a bicycle behind the car.

examples.japanese: {後|うし}ろ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれました→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: Someone called my name from behind.

notes:
{後|うし}ろ indicates spatial position at the back or rear of something.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{後|うし}ろ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: behind ~
- {後|うし}ろ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look behind
- {後|うし}ろ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from behind
- {後|うし}ろ⟦{向|む}き→向き：12041_muki⟧: facing backward
- {後|うし}ろ⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: figure from behind

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: front

WATCH OUT:
- {後|うし}ろ: behind (spatial)
- ⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧: after (temporal), later
- ⟦{後|ご}→後：noentry⟧: after, post- (in compounds)

KO-SO-A-DO PATTERN:
Used with demonstratives: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{後|うし}ろ, ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{後|うし}ろ, etc.
